source: Written for this project, NOT AI Video Bootcamp material: the physical consequences of weight and touch that image models leave out - a cushion that does not dip under a body, a hand that holds a mug without pressing into it, a sleeve that never creases at the elbow. Each phrase names something a camera would record.
note: Read from Subject, Action, Posing and Setting (build_contact.py). `supports` are what the subject rests on, `actions` what it is doing; each entry is matched by whole-word keywords and carries one phrase per subject kind it applies to - an entry with no phrase for a kind is skipped for that kind, so a table never gets 'forearms resting' on a perfume bottle. Matches are used in the order the text mentions them, at most `max_phrases`. With no match, `by_kind` supplies `default_count` phrase(s), picked reproducibly by seed. A place has no defaults: an empty street has nothing pressing on anything. Deformation only - contact SHADOWS belong to scene_light_bank.json.

sofa.label: Sofa / cushions
sofa.human: the seat cushion dipping and creasing under the body's weight, fabric pulled taut around the hollow
sofa.animal: the cushion dipping into a soft hollow beneath it, fabric creased around the body
sofa.object: the cushion dipping slightly under the object's weight, fabric creased around its base

bed.label: Bed / duvet
bed.human: the bedding pressed into soft hollows under the body, rumpled where it was moved
bed.animal: the bedding sinking into a shallow nest under the body, rumpled around it
bed.object: the bedding sinking slightly under the object, the fabric creased around it

lap.label: Lap
lap.human: the fabric across the lap pulled and creased under the weight resting on it
lap.animal: the body settled heavily into the lap, fur flattened against the fabric beneath

grass.label: Grass
grass.human: the grass bent flat and pressed down where the body's weight rests on it
grass.animal: the grass flattened and bent under the paws and body, blades poking up around them
grass.object: the grass bent and pushed aside around the object's base

sand.label: Sand
sand.human: feet and hands sinking slightly into the sand, the grains pushed up in small ridges around them
sand.animal: paws sinking into the sand, grains pushed up in small ridges around each one
sand.object: the object settled into the sand, grains piled slightly against its base

snow.label: Snow
snow.human: boots pressed into the snow, compacted footprints with crisp edges around them
snow.animal: paws sinking into the snow, compacted prints with crumbling edges around them
snow.object: the object pressed into the snow, a compacted rim around its base

water.label: Water
water.human: the water surface displaced around the body, small ripples spreading from where it meets the skin
water.animal: the water displaced around the legs, small ripples spreading from where it touches the fur
water.object: the water displaced around the object, small ripples spreading from where it meets the surface

chair.label: Chair / stool / bench
chair.human: the body's weight settled into the seat, clothing pulled and creased where it meets the chair
chair.animal: the body settled onto the seat, fur flattened where it presses against it

table.label: Table / counter / desk
table.human: forearms resting on the surface with real weight, skin pressed slightly flat where it meets it
table.animal: paws spread with the pads pressed flat where they meet the surface
table.object: the object sitting with real weight where it stands, a thin dark line where its base meets the surface

floor.label: Floor / rug
floor.human: the body's weight settled onto the floor, clothing pooling and creasing where it meets the ground
floor.animal: the body settled onto the floor, fur flattened and parted where it presses down
floor.object: the object resting with real weight on the floor, a thin dark line where it meets the ground

wall.label: Wall
wall.human: the shoulder pressed against the wall, jacket fabric bunching where the weight leans into it

holding.label: Holding / gripping
holding.human: fingers pressing into what they hold, the skin around the knuckles tightening with the grip

hugging.label: Hugging
hugging.human: clothing pulled and bunched where the arms wrap around, fabric pressed flat between the bodies

carrying.label: Carrying
carrying.human: the arms and shoulders visibly taking the load, fabric pulled taut across the back

sitting.label: Sitting
sitting.human: clothing creasing at the hips and behind the knees where the body folds as it sits
sitting.animal: the haunches settled heavily, fur bunching where the body folds as it sits

lying.label: Lying / asleep
lying.human: hair spreading out and clothing gathering in folds on the side the body rests on
lying.animal: fur pressed flat and parted on the side it lies on, the body heavy and loose

leaning.label: Leaning
leaning.human: weight shifted onto the side that leans, clothing pulled across the body in the direction of the weight

kneeling.label: Kneeling
kneeling.human: trousers stretched tight across the bent knees, fabric bunching at the backs of the legs

human: clothing creasing and bunching naturally where the body bends at the elbows and waist
hair falling with real weight, resting on the shoulders and parting where it lies
fabric hanging with real weight, pulled taut at the shoulders and loose where it falls
animal: fur flattened and parted where the body presses against the surface beneath
the paws spreading slightly under the body's weight, pads pressed flat
object: the object sitting with real weight on its surface, a thin dark line where its base meets it
